# Core Rule 2 - Do not use information gained outside of in-character means
Using external applications like discord to gain an in game advantage is prohibited.
## Examples
### [bold] Permitted [/bold]
- Talking in VC with friends, as long as it is not about in round events. - Streaming the server. - Playing on the server with friends. - Planning actions with friends.
### [bold] Not Permitted [/bold]
- Using VC as a means to get an in game advantage and share information. - Giving your friends in game advantages without reason.
